classification: survey_only execution-integration research; no physics, numerics, rounding, CUDA arithmetic or precision policy is changed. Sealed before any code of this experiment.
branch: claude/adaptive-execution-v1 (parent 436e2ff = claude/gpu-long-trajectory-v1, main checkout, no worktree, no push, no merge)
goal: Connect the verified executors (CPU E2 serial, CPU E2 W-worker parallel, GPU_V1 hybrid) behind one service that picks the execution plan from the request and the environment. The selector may change only HOW a pass is executed (backend, worker count, CPU placement, GPU block); it never changes the evaluator, the precision p, the P2 rule, the readout or the outcome.

structural_problems_confirmed_in_code.A_cpu_selector_hardware: selector_service_v1.selector._supported_topology accepts exactly 6 logical = 6 physical CPUs without SMT, cores 0..5; worker_count() is a laptop rule (T=100: N<=4 serial, 5<=N<12 W4, N>=12 W6; T=1000: N=3 W3, N>=4 W6) and was wrong at N=8 T=100 (W6 6.1% faster than the chosen W4). It is not reused as a rule; only ExecutionPlan and the runners are reused.
structural_problems_confirmed_in_code.B_gpu_long_t1000_only: gpu_long_trajectory_v1.long.long_pass loops over the module constant T = 1000 and has no T argument. gpu_short_trajectory_v1.traj.hybrid_trajectory takes T but returns no pass_record (it has 'read' = decide / endpoints_key and checkpoint states) and uses CHECKS[100] for T = 100. Both are frozen; neither is edited nor monkey-patched (no module global is changed).
structural_problems_confirmed_in_code.C_gpu_precision: GPU support set {64, 73, 78, 109, 128, 161, 163, 166, 192} (gpu_long_trajectory_v1.support.SEALED_EXT_P). support.ExtPV.upload widens gpu_host.SUPPORTED_P (a module global) for the duration of one upload call.
structural_problems_confirmed_in_code.E_found_while_reading: long.long_pass maps a mid-pass GPU refusal (REFUSED_DEVICE_WIDTH / REFUSED_DEVICE_PRECISION from encode or the device) into readout(stop_kind = 'REFUSED_...'), and multiatom_parallel_v1.run._readout maps an unknown stop to outcome UNDECIDED_AT_PRECISION. Unhandled, P2 would treat a device refusal as missing precision and raise p. The adapter must classify GPU statuses itself (rule 'gpu_status_classes').

modules.environment.py: collects the environment record and env_id (rule 'environment')
modules.profiles.py: loads the sealed correctness profile (this protocol, section 'correctness_profile') and sealed per-environment performance profiles (rule 'performance_profile'); hash-checked at load; read-only
modules.selector.py: pure function: (pass request view, environment record, correctness profile, performance profile or None, goal) -> AdaptivePlan or refusal; never sees a pass record
modules.adapters.py: re-checks every plan against the environment and the correctness profile before execution; CPU: the unchanged experiments/w5_placement_v1/run.py in a fresh process per pass (ExecutionPlan, multiatom_parallel_v1.run.run_serial / e2_pair_parallel_v1.run.run_parallel); GPU: one dedicated GPU worker process that owns one gpu_long_trajectory_v1.long.LongExecutor and serves one request at a time
modules.service.py: one request from start p to a final status: start p decision, P2 loop, per-pass selection, adapter, GPU-status classification, CPU fallback, ledger
modules.experience.py: start-p chain over the sealed EXPERIENCE_START_P_V2 store (read-only) and candidate records (never read by any policy)
modules.campaign.py: phases env / gate100 / calibrate / evaluate / replay; fault switches for the tests only

environment.env_id: sha256 of the canonical JSON of every field above except volatile ones (hostname, time, load). It identifies a hardware / software configuration, not a physical machine: two machines with the same configuration share an env_id (disclosed limitation; their performance may still differ).
environment.gpu_correctness_key: (gpu_sources hash table, arch sm_XY from the compute capability, mpmath_version, mpmath_backend)
environment.a_matching_env_id_proves_nothing_about_c: correctness comes only from the correctness profile; env_id only selects a performance profile

CPU_E2.physics_contract_hash: must equal the sealed experience bundle's (5d76fa2a...)
CPU_E2.numeric_contract_hash: must equal the sealed experience bundle's (85653a0a...)
CPU_E2.note: CPU E2 is the reference executor; in an environment whose cpu_correctness_key does not match, every request is REFUSED_UNVERIFIED_ENVIRONMENT (fail-closed).

GPU_V1.contract: GPU_LONG_TRAJECTORY_V1 section 6: GPU computes the per-atom force (pair -> G -> J -> canonical per-atom sum), the CPU owns kick / drift; block 32; model re-upload only when p changes
GPU_V1.gpu_sources_sha256_lf: recorded from GPU_LONG_TRAJECTORY_V1 vast_run/env.json source table and re-hashed at code seal; any difference -> GPU refused
GPU_V1.domain_T100_condition: only if 'gate100' passes on the host before evaluation; otherwise T = 100 is CPU-only in V1 and is reported as not connected
GPU_V1.evidence: T1000: N12 / N16 at p 64,73,78,161,163,166 and N40 at p109 (GPU_LONG); T100: N12 / N16 p163, N40 / N64 / N128 p109, N64 p163 (GPU_SHORT). N values between or outside these are UNKNOWN and are not GPU domain (no interpolation).
GPU_V1.outside: p not in support_p, N or T outside the domain, unverified arch / mpmath / sources, no GPU -> the pass runs on the CPU at exactly the requested p (never moved to a supported p)
GPU_V1.level: numerically validated candidate (bit-identical on sealed trajectories and services); not formally certified for all inputs

gpu_status_classes.DOMAIN_STOP_VIOLATED / DOMAIN_STOP_UNPRO: physics domain stop; outcome DOMAIN_VIOLATED_PROVEN / DOMAIN_UNPROVEN, a P2 input
gpu_status_classes.REFUSED_* (device width, device precisio: DEVICE_REFUSAL event: not a P2 input; the same p is re-run on CPU serial (fallback reason DEVICE_REFUSAL); the event is kept in the ledger
gpu_status_classes.exception from the GPU worker / dead wor: DEVICE_ERROR event: not a P2 input; same p re-run on CPU serial; event kept; any correctness anomaly is reported separately and never folded into the outcome
gpu_status_classes.precision echo mismatch (device_p != req: GPU_PRECISION_MISMATCH: the pass is INVALID_EVIDENCE (final); never silently re-run
gpu_status_classes.computation mismatch: only detectable by the independent replay (checker); a mismatch makes the run ADAPTIVE_FAIL

start_p.chain: EXACT_MEMORY if the sealed store has a VERIFIED exact success for fingerprint(physics, numeric, evaluator, initial_state_digest, T): start = its lowest_observed_success_p; else FAMILY_MAX of family_key(T, evaluator, physics, numeric); else 64. No interpolation over T; no new policy.

other_start_modes (baselines / tests).FIXED_START:<p>: a sealed test request whose first p is given (used for p = 162)

start_p.fingerprint_checks_before_use: initial_state_digest is the exact-fraction digest of scenarios.initial(N) (multiatom_parallel_v1.run.initial_digest) and must be the same whatever p the pass will use; fingerprints must differ when N, T, evaluator, physics or numeric hash differ (unit tests)
start_p.store_is_read_only: the sealed bundle hash is checked at load; no record of this experiment is ever added to it; new records go to candidates/ as UNVERIFIED

placement.candidates: SERIAL (main on the first allowed CPU), W3, W4, W6
placement.rule: worker CPUs = the first W allowed CPUs (ascending number) that lie on pairwise distinct physical cores, taking at most one logical CPU per core (SMT siblings unused). W3 / W4: main on a further distinct core (W + 1 cores). W6: main shares the core of worker 6 (the W5_PLACEMENT_V1 layout, 6 cores). A placement is VALID only if all its CPUs are allowed, the cores are distinct, and the number of cores it uses <= floor(cpu_quota) when a quota exists.
placement.invalid: an invalid placement is not a candidate; if no parallel placement is valid only SERIAL remains
placement.placement_id: sha256 of (W, main CPU, worker CPUs, core of each); a performance row is usable only if its placement_id equals the placement computed now in the same env_id

performance_profile.unit: one row per (env_id, N, T, strategy) with strategy in SERIAL / W3 / W4 / W6 / GPU: p_measured, placement_id, per-repeat end-to-end pass wall seconds and CPU seconds (all processes of the pass), GPU worker startup separately, load average per repeat
performance_profile.measured_in: phase 'calibrate' on the official host, committed (sealed) before 'evaluate'
performance_profile.p_assumption_A_P: a row measured at p_measured is used for every p of the same (N, T) class. This is an explicit sealed assumption (relative order of strategies does not change with p in 64..192); the evaluation measures fixed strategies at several p and reports whether the order changes. It is not interpolation over N or T: an unmeasured (N, T) class has no row.
performance_profile.never_mixed: rows of another env_id are never used; the GPU_LONG Vast perf numbers stay as reference only

selector.inputs: N, T, p, goal, environment record, correctness profile, performance profile of env_id (or none)
selector.refusals: cpu_correctness_key unverified -> REFUSED_UNVERIFIED_ENVIRONMENT; T or N outside CPU_E2 domain -> UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST
selector.gpu_eligible: GPU present AND gpu_correctness_key verified AND p in support_p AND N in domain of T AND (T = 1000 or gate100 passed)
selector.WALL_MIN: no performance profile for env_id -> SERIAL (reason NO_PERF_PROFILE). (N, T) class without rows -> SERIAL (reason PERF_CLASS_UNMEASURED). Else candidates = SERIAL + valid parallel placements with a row + GPU if eligible with a row; pick the smallest median pass wall; a candidate within 5% of the smallest median (relative to the smaller) ties with it and the tie is broken by the smaller median CPU seconds, then by fewer workers. GPU is never chosen without an eligible GPU row.
selector.CPU_MIN: SERIAL always (sealed conservative rule from the CPU-only comparisons); the GPU CPU time is measured and reported, not used in V1
selector.no_feedback: the selector never receives a pass record; nothing it learns during the evaluation changes a later choice

service.loop: p0 = start p; later p = P2(history) unchanged; every pass from the original (q0, p0) at that p (GPU: long.initial(N, p) fresh per pass; CPU: a fresh process); per pass: plan = selector (or the fixed baseline plan), adapter re-check, execution, classification; MAX_PASSES 24; CAP as P2
service.fallback: a GPU plan refused by the adapter, a DEVICE_REFUSAL or a DEVICE_ERROR -> the same p on CPU serial; the ledger keeps both the event and the CPU pass; the label of the service is GPU_FULL_RETRY / GPU_WITH_CPU_FALLBACK / CPU_ONLY
service.gpu_serialization: exactly one GPU worker process per service host; the client holds a lock and sends one request at a time; the support-set widening of ExtPV happens only inside that process
ledger_per_pass: effective_p (CPU iv.prec / GPU device_p and echo)
outcome / stop / stop_step / completed_steps / cells / endpoints_key
CPU s of every process of the pass
ledger_per_service: GPU worker startup (reported separately; the worker is warm across services)

verification_costs_separated.service_cost: what the service does per request: selection, passes, readout, ledger. No replay.
verification_costs_separated.independent_replay_cost: the checker recomputes every distinct (N, T, p) pass with its own KDK and its own force code (gpu_short_trajectory_v1.checker.my_forces: no GPU, no stream.run, no runner import) and compares outcome, stop, stop_step, completed_steps, cells and endpoints_key; measured and reported separately; it is part of the evaluation, not of the service
verification_costs_separated.levels: evaluation passes are REPLAY-CHECKED for this experiment only; this is not formal soundness and not the REPLAY_VERIFIED grade of the A three-layer contract

GPU-unsupported p -> exact CPU fallback (seen class, unseen p)
N outside GPU domain and unmeasured performance class (unseen)
EXACT_MEMORY 109 at T = 100; GPU only if gate100 passed (seen class)

strategies.ADAPTIVE_CPU: selector, goal CPU_MIN (repeat 1: its plans are SERIAL by rule; this run checks plans and records CPU time; its cost is otherwise FIXED_SERIAL's)
strategies.FIXED_W6: every pass W6 if the host has a valid W6 placement (repeats 5)
strategies.FIXED_GPU: every pass GPU, only for requests whose every expected pass is inside the GPU profile (R1-R4, R8 if gate100 passed); never run outside (repeats 5)

order_and_repeats: repeat 1 of every (request, strategy) is the correctness run; the checker (replay) gates before repeats 2..5; in each repeat the strategy order is rotated by the repeat index; /proc/loadavg every 10 s and before / after each service; records of later repeats must be bit-identical in outcome fields to repeat 1
seen_vs_unseen: seen = (N, T) class in the calibration set (R1-R6, R8); unseen = R7; reported separately
official_host: Vast 52763685 (RTX 3090 sm_86, Threadripper PRO 3975WX, about 16 effective CPUs under a cgroup quota, 64 logical visible). Two jobs: job 1 = tests + env + gate100 + calibrate (stop after a grace period); commit of the calibration profile (seal) locally; job 2 = tests + env (must equal the sealed env_id, else stop) + gate100 + evaluate repeat 1 + replay + checker gate + repeats 2..5 + analysis; each job stops the instance itself. A host change needs an amendment before any official run.

decision_rules_sealed.ADAPTIVE_FAIL: any of: a result whose computational meaning changed (replay mismatch, endpoint or outcome difference between strategies at the same p); a GPU pass outside the correctness profile accepted as normal; a precision disguise; a retry not from the original state; a wrong stop or outcome; an evidence integrity failure (checker not EVIDENCE OK)
decision_rules_sealed.gain_metrics: on seen requests (R1-R6, R8): G_W6 = sum of ADAPTIVE_WALL median service wall / sum of FIXED_W6 medians; G_best = sum ADAPTIVE_WALL / min(sum FIXED_SERIAL, sum FIXED_W6) (the best uniform CPU baseline the service could use without a selector). Per request: oracle = smallest median among the strategies run for it; ratio = ADAPTIVE_WALL / oracle.
decision_rules_sealed.ADAPTIVE_V1_READY: no FAIL; GPU support / refusal rules held in every case (incl. environment cases and forced-GPU refusals); placement checks passed; P2 and start-p meaning preserved; checker EVIDENCE OK; G_best <= 0.85 (practical gain) and no big cost deterioration: sum of ADAPTIVE_WALL medians over seen requests <= 1.10 x sum of the per-request oracle medians + 0.5 s per ADAPTIVE_WALL pass (selection and noise allowance)
decision_rules_sealed.ADAPTIVE_EXACT_NOT_USEFUL: no FAIL but G_best > 0.85 or the deterioration bound fails
decision_rules_sealed.counterexamples: every request with ratio > 1.10 is listed as a cost-policy counterexample with its cause (unmeasured class, p assumption, noise); unseen requests (R7) and environment cases are reported separately and do not enter G_best; rules are not changed during the evaluation

not_in_scope: automatic certification of an unseen CPU / GPU environment (ADAPTIVE_EXECUTION_VERIFICATION_V0)
claims_forbidden: formal soundness of GPU_V1 or of the service
REPLAY_VERIFIED grade in the sense of the A three-layer contract
performance of an environment that was not measured
that an env_id match proves correctness
that T = 1000 evidence covers longer trajectories
